description.id: Ringkasan naratif 25 nabi yang disusun SELA dari ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an yang dirujuk, dengan rujukan di setiap bagian. Draf: semua 25 sudah ditulis, tetapi belum ditelaah ulama.
description.en: Narrative summaries of the 25 prophets written by SELA from the cited Quran passages, with references on every section. Draft: all 25 are written, but not yet reviewed by scholars.

source.label: Kisah Para Nabi — Pustaka Lajnah Kemenag
